sql.elexon/fou2t14d: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "silver_elexon_fou2t14d_latest" AS SELECT * FROM "silver_elexon_fou2t14d" QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "settlement_date", "fuel_type", "settlement_period" ORDER BY "available_at" DESC NULLS LAST) = 1
sql.elexon/remit: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "silver_elexon_remit_latest" AS SELECT * FROM "silver_elexon_remit" QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "mrid" ORDER BY "available_at" DESC NULLS LAST, "revision_number" DESC NULLS LAST) = 1
sql.elexon/system_prices: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "silver_elexon_system_prices_latest" AS SELECT * FROM "silver_elexon_system_prices" QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "settlement_date", "settlement_period" ORDER BY "available_at" DESC NULLS LAST, CASE "run_type" WHEN 'II' THEN 1 WHEN 'SF' THEN 2 WHEN 'R1' THEN 3 WHEN 'R2' THEN 4 WHEN 'R3' THEN 5 WHEN 'RF' THEN 6 WHEN 'DF' THEN 7 ELSE 0 END DESC, "run_type" DESC NULLS LAST) = 1

views: CREATE VIEW silver_elexon_fou2t14d AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('<DATA>/silver/elexon/fou2t14d/**/[!.]*.parquet', (hive_partitioning = CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN)), (union_by_name = CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN)));

CREATE VIEW silver_elexon_fou2t14d_latest AS SELECT * FROM silver_elexon_fou2t14d QUALIFY (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY settlement_date, fuel_type, settlement_period ORDER BY available_at DESC NULLS LAST, "month" DESC NULLS LAST, "value" DESC NULLS LAST, "year" DESC NULLS LAST) = 1);
CREATE VIEW silver_elexon_mid AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('<DATA>/silver/elexon/mid/**/[!.]*.parquet', (hive_partitioning = CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN)), (union_by_name = CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN)));
CREATE VIEW silver_elexon_remit AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('<DATA>/silver/elexon/remit/**/[!.]*.parquet', (hive_partitioning = CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN)), (union_by_name = CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN)));

CREATE VIEW silver_elexon_remit_latest AS SELECT * FROM silver_elexon_remit QUALIFY (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY mrid ORDER BY available_at DESC NULLS LAST, revision_number DESC NULLS LAST, "month" DESC NULLS LAST, "value" DESC NULLS LAST, "year" DESC NULLS LAST) = 1);

CREATE VIEW silver_elexon_system_prices AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('<DATA>/silver/elexon/system_prices/**/[!.]*.parquet', (hive_partitioning = CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN)), (union_by_name = CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN)));

CREATE VIEW silver_elexon_system_prices_latest AS SELECT * FROM silver_elexon_system_prices QUALIFY (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY settlement_date, settlement_period ORDER BY available_at DESC NULLS LAST, CASE  WHEN ((run_type = 'II')) THEN (1) WHEN ((run_type = 'SF')) THEN (2) WHEN ((run_type = 'R1')) THEN (3) WHEN ((run_type = 'R2')) THEN (4) WHEN ((run_type = 'R3')) THEN (5) WHEN ((run_type = 'RF')) THEN (6) WHEN ((run_type = 'DF')) THEN (7) ELSE 0 END DESC, "month" DESC NULLS LAST, run_type DESC NULLS LAST, "value" DESC NULLS LAST, "year" DESC NULLS LAST) = 1);
